name: motion-spring-bounce
title: Bounce
description: Lò xo nảy rõ hai lần, vượt 24 % rồi dừng sau khoảng 0.82 giây; chỉ cho trò chơi, linh vật, khoảnh khắc chính.5, 11.25)).

moworks.author: moworks

options.prop: the property it drives: x | y | scale | rotation (x)

moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 1 on a spring, stiffness 150, damping 9, mass 0.8 (damping ratio 0.41): 24.3 % overshoot, within 1 % by ~820 ms. Kit form: springk(187.5, 11.25) over 0.82 s. Rule: clearly bounces twice; play, mascots and hero moments only. Small demo: the target moves 102 px beside the response graph, with overshoot and settle readouts. Params: stiffness (150) · damping (9) · mass (0.8) · duration (0.82 s). Damping ratio 0.41: about 24 % past, two clear bounces, settled by ~0.82 s. Only for play, mascots and hero moments.
